pages.title: Helladotherium
pages.text: Helladotherium ($(o)Helladotherium duvernoyi$()) is an extinct giraffid that lived in southern Europe and western Asia during the Late Miocene, and is best known from fossils found at Pikermi in Greece.$(br2)It was a large, robust animal with a relatively short neck, more like an outsized okapi than a modern giraffe.$(br2)Wear on its teeth shows that it was a browser, feeding on the leaves of trees and shrubs.
